set.body: Model the archive contract as Scala 3 values: ArchiveId or LnaVersion, RunId, ArchivePath, DatasetRef, DatasetRole, LnaDType, TransformDescriptor, TransformStep, ArchiveManifest, PayloadPlan, checksum policy, and ArchiveError. Prefer opaque identifiers, enums, case classes, Either-returning validators, and immutable plans over mutable registries or stringly option bags.
set.title: LNA archive core model and descriptor algebra
